content.short: Solvent is an NFT lending protocol that converts NFTs into fungible tokens, enabling lending, fractional ownership, and passive income.
content.description: Solvent is an early liquidity platform for NFTs on Solana. Users deposit their NFTs into a Solvent NFT collection (bucket), which mints droplets that can be used for lending, fractional ownership of NFTs, and to earn passive income. Solvent relies on AMM-based floor prices to determine collateralized loan amounts, converting NFT holdings into liquid collateral and enabling borrowers to access liquidity against their assets.
content.meta: Solvent is an NFT lending protocol that lets NFT holders convert NFTs into fungible tokens. Discover Solvent and other NFT Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
